title: ROOT10 applies a flat discount instead of a percentage
reproduction: Add Studio Headphones and apply ROOT10. Compare the cart preview and confirmed checkout total.
expected_root_cause: The UI calculates 10 percent while PricingService caps and returns a fixed $10 discount.

title: A delayed payment response causes duplicate captures
reproduction: Place an order with a total of at least $100, then inspect its payment ledger in /dev.
expected_root_cause: The first capture succeeds, the response times out, and ShopService retries with a different idempotency key.

title: Successful checkouts do not reduce available inventory
reproduction: Buy the same product repeatedly and compare availability with successful orders.
expected_root_cause: InventoryService verifies stock but never decrements it after reservation.
